heat.label: Heatwave
heat.history: July 1993 Philadelphia heat wave (100+ heat deaths) led to the city's Heat Health Emergency program and Heatline.

refuge.label: Cooling center
refuge.desc: Air-conditioned cooling center open 9am–8pm at the chosen site.

transit.label: Free SEPTA to cooling
transit.desc: Free fares + extended hours on routes to the city's existing library cooling sites.

alert.label: Early heat alert
alert.desc: Heat Health Emergency declared a day early: Heatline, block-captain checks, outdoor work shifted to dawn.

smoke.label: Wildfire smoke
smoke.history: June 2023 Canadian wildfire smoke pushed Philadelphia's AQI into the hazardous range and triggered a Code Red.

refuge.label: Clean-air center
refuge.desc: HEPA-filtered clean-air center open 9am–8pm at the chosen site.

n95.label: N95 giveaway
n95.desc: Free N95s at libraries, rec centers and outreach vans; masks cut outdoor PM2.5 dose ~70%.

alert.label: Code Red air alert
alert.desc: Early air-quality alert: outdoor events cancelled, outdoor work paused above AQI 200.

flood.label: Flash flood
flood.history: Hurricane Ida remnants, Sept 2021: the Schuylkill posted its highest crest in over a century and I-676 (Vine St Expressway) flooded.

refuge.label: Emergency shelter
refuge.desc: Shelter opened at the chosen site from 3pm; flood-zone residents told to evacuate there.

closures.label: Pre-emptive road closures
closures.desc: Flood-prone roads (Kelly/MLK Dr, I-676, riverside) closed before the storm; trips rerouted.

alert.label: Early flood warning
alert.desc: Flash-flood warning pushed 3 hours earlier with 'don't drive' guidance.

cold.label: Winter storm
cold.history: Philadelphia Code Blue: declared when temperature or wind chill drops to 20°F or below; unsheltered residents at highest risk.

refuge.label: Warming center
refuge.desc: 24-hour Code Blue warming center at the chosen site.

outreach.label: Outreach + open stations
outreach.desc: Homeless outreach vans and SEPTA concourses kept open overnight as refuge.

alert.label: Early Code Blue
alert.desc: Code Blue declared early with utility shutoff moratorium; heat restored for many shut-off homes.

reasons.unaware: didn't hear the warning, kept their routine
reasons.avoid_hazard: heard the warning and stayed in instead of going out
reasons.shift_early: moved the activity to a safer hour of the day
reasons.work_continues: employer kept the outdoor shift going
reasons.alert_shift: employer shifted or paused outdoor work after the official alert
reasons.self_break: took an indoor break from outdoor work
reasons.seek_refuge: went to the official refuge (cooling / clean-air / warming center or shelter)
reasons.too_far: refuge was too far to reach without a car or transit
reasons.informal_refuge: spent hours in a nearby library or rec centre to escape conditions
reasons.no_option: had nowhere better to go, stayed put
reasons.ac_cost: has AC but kept it off to save on the electric bill
reasons.evacuate: left a flood-prone home for the shelter
reasons.delay_trip: waited out the storm before driving
reasons.detour: road closure forced a detour around flooded streets
reasons.heat_restored: utility shutoff moratorium restored their heat
reasons.masked: wore an N95 from the giveaway

no_ac_base.source: EIA RECS 2020: ~9 in 10 Mid-Atlantic homes use AC

no_ac_poverty_add.source: RECS 2020: AC access lower in low-income households (assumed gap)

no_heat_poverty_add.source: RECS 2020: unsafe indoor temps concentrated in low-income homes (assumed)
